description: This file defines the 'Kpi' entity class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes properties like id, title, ratings, and associations with job titles, mapped via Doctrine ORM annotations. It serves as a data model for KPI (Key Performance Indicator) records in the system.

classes.name: Kpi
classes.description: Entity class representing a KPI record with properties for ID, title, ratings, default flag, deletion timestamp, and associated job title, with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the KPI.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the KPI.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title/indicator of the KPI.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title/indicator of the KPI.

methods.name: isDefaultKpi
methods.description: Returns whether this is a default KPI.

methods.name: setDefaultKpi
methods.description: Sets whether this is a default KPI.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with this KPI.

methods.name: getDeletedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the KPI was marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeletedAt
methods.description: Sets the deletion timestamp for the KPI.
